answer: Escalating escrowed bonds break sybil economics. A newcomer locks a base bond of 500 stake units for thirty days, and the required bond doubles with each account registered under one verified operator, so ten clones pay 2^10 base. Two established attesters co-sign before activation; a rotating dawn audit samples five percent of identities per epoch and burns the whole ladder on any proven duplicate; and the attestation cipher admits only established peers, so a forge of forgeries cannot self-vouch upward. Each marginal fake costs more than it can ever earn.
